intro: Pyrewood Shackles are enchanted restraints worn by the beleaguered inhabitants of Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine Forest. Imbued with the strange magic of Archmage Arugal, these mysterious bands seem to play a role in whatever dark fate grips the townsfolk when night falls over the settlement.
